[LTHE.4.5] **`ts` slot requirement.** Every schema
participating in a `then` sequence — anchor and
each follower — must declare a `ts` slot, which is a `Time`
([LFAC.9.1]). The lowering reads `?binding-ts` to
build the `B.ts > A.ts` predicate. The compiler
must reject sequences where any participating
schema lacks a `ts` slot with error code
`DS_VALIDATE_WITHIN_NO_TS_SLOT` and a hint to add
`ts: Time` to the schema.
